skills.description: Turn any software with a codebase into an agent-native CLI — a stateful command-line interface an AI agent can drive without a GUI, screenshot automation, or a dumbed-down reimplementation. Use this skill whenever the user wants to build a CLI or harness for a GUI/desktop application (Blender, GIMP, Inkscape, LibreOffice, FreeCAD, QGIS, Shotcut, Kdenlive, Audacity, OBS, Godot, MuseScore, Zotero, drawio, Obsidian), asks how to let an agent operate real professional software, wants to make software "agent-native" / "agent 可用" / "AI 能操作", needs the cli-anything / CLI-Hub methodology, wants to generate a harness, review or validate an existing harness against HARNESS.md, refine a harness to expand its coverage, produce the SKILL.md for a generated CLI, package a harness as a PEP 420 namespace package, or browse, install and preflight the CLI-Hub catalog (cli-hub install, cli-hub matrix, CLI 矩阵, 能力矩阵, CLI 清单). Also use it when the user references HKUDS/CLI-Anything, HARNESS.md, a cli-anything-{software} command, an agent-harness directory, or asks to make software usable by agents. Repackaged from HKUDS/CLI-Anything (Apache-2.0).
skills.description_zh: 这个技能的核心目标是：把任何只有 GUI 的软件，变成 AI Agent 能稳定调用的命令行工具。 它不是靠视觉识别去"点界面"，而是通过一套 7 阶段自动化流水线（HARNESS.md），让 AI Agent 自己分析源码、生成 CLI、写测试、打包发布。
skills.name: CLI-Anything
